capabilities: Toggle disguise mode from a sidebar button
Obscure editor text and background colors with CSS
Adjust disguise styles by editing the plugin's styles.css
extras: Bilingual README (English and Chinese). Disguise mode does not apply to Reading view, has no command for toggling, and styles cannot be configured in settings — only by editing the plugin's styles.css file.
motivation: The author wants to prevent people passing by in public spaces from too easily reading the content being edited.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to quickly hide or obscure on-screen editing content when working in public spaces.
summary: Toggle that obscures editor text and background colors via CSS so nearby people in public spaces cannot read what you type.
